NER.note: Document states nothing on rules or an authority for AI harms.
Rayuwa is an agro-hydro-meteorological advisory platform for producers, a sector tool rather than AI for general administration.

facts.fact: ADN says Rayuwa, an AI platform with a text and voice assistant, image-based crop disease diagnosis and location-based forecasts, is free on the Play Store, and that technical staff of the national meteorology, water resources and plant protection directorates were trained on 27-28 August 2025 and given administrator accounts to manage its content.

ADN describes itself as a key actor in developing and operationalising Rayuwa, an AI platform available free on the Play Store, targeting 600,000 Nigerien producers within 2.3 million beneficiaries in West Africa.

NER.note: Document names the national meteorology directorate only as a trainee, and states nothing on satellite data.
